checks: First-level navigation has no function icons; all expanded menus retain loaded icons
Open from another page immediately shows the chooser; cancel changes nothing and double submit opens the selected method once
Opening failure keeps the chooser and selection, preserves the current method, and can be retried
Unsaved edits block opening without losing content; parameter and spectral-line shortcuts open the exact views
New and Save As open their forms directly and create real separate records while preserving the source version
Pre-record focuses sample input and Enter saves a sample; capture and analysis reach their operating workspaces
Chooser and text-only first-level navigation fit both window sizes and both themes
The chooser retains method-file opening, and cancelling its file picker leaves the current method intact
Accounts without method write permission have no mutating method shortcuts
